summary: Six recipes and eleven shred yield classes. The retail August recipe set is no longer a design guess: the owner's 2026-08-22 admin capture holds two identical 936-byte 26 09 Recipe.List packets, and docs/62's August-derived record layout consumes 936 of 936 bytes of them (D256). Every display field on the wire is that item's own ClientItemDefinitions row, so the six records are reproducible byte for byte from client data plus the captured counts. What stays DESIGN: the craft duration (D257 - the owner's own Z1 under D53, because the client carries none), the craft animation, and the shred yields, because no item row in the 2,643-row catalogue carries DATASHEET_ID 25 (ShreddableItemDatasheet) - the client ships no yields at all (docs/59 s1.1).
